CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_inventory_movement(p_material_id uuid, p_movement_type text, p_quantity_delta_base numeric, p_unit_cost_base_per_base_unit numeric DEFAULT NULL::numeric, p_occurred_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(), p_source_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_source_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_source_line_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_note text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
    v_movement_id uuid;
begin

    if not public.is_app_owner() then
        raise exception 'Access denied';
    end if;


    if p_quantity_delta_base is null
       or p_quantity_delta_base = 0 then

        raise exception
            'Inventory quantity cannot be zero';

    end if;


    if not exists (
        select 1
        from public.materials
        where id = p_material_id
          and is_active = true
    ) then

        raise exception 'Material not found';

    end if;


    insert into public.inventory_movements (
        material_id,
        movement_type,
        quantity_delta_base,
        unit_cost_base_per_base_unit,
        occurred_at,
        source_type,
        source_id,
        source_line_id,
        note
    )
    values (
        p_material_id,
        p_movement_type,
        p_quantity_delta_base,
        p_unit_cost_base_per_base_unit,
        p_occurred_at,
        p_source_type,
        p_source_id,
        p_source_line_id,
        p_note
    )
    returning id
    into v_movement_id;


    update public.materials
    set current_stock_base =
        current_stock_base + p_quantity_delta_base
    where id = p_material_id;


    return v_movement_id;

end;
$function$
